steps: The rule says only the culprit fibs, so exactly one statement is false, and it belongs to the culprit.
Pablo says Yusuf is telling the truth, so Pablo's and Yusuf's statements are both true or both false.
Both false would mean two fibbers. So both are true, and neither Pablo nor Yusuf is the culprit.
Yusuf says Arlo or Pablo salted the lemonade. It was not Pablo, so it was Arlo.
Check Arlo: his statement blaming Della is false, and the other four are true. Only the culprit fibs, so Arlo fits.
